decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly put powerful creatures from the graveyard onto the battlefield using cards like Reanimate, Animate Dead, and Shallow Grave. By utilizing cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal to generate mana, as well as disruption spells like Unmask and Cabal Therapy to disrupt the opponent's strategy, this deck aims to bring out high-impact creatures such as Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty early in the game to overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Thoughtseize and Entomb further help to control the game and set up powerful plays.

The deck focuses on utilizing disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also deploying aggressive threats like Stoneforge Mystic and Skyclave Apparition to apply pressure. The deck also includes powerful synergies with cards like Aether Vial and Recruiter of the Guard to efficiently search for key pieces. The deck aims to maintain control of the board through removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Solitude while deploying its own threats to close out the game quickly. The mana base is designed to support the deck's game plan and provide consistency in casting its spells.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through lands and disrupting the opponent's strategy. By utilizing cards like Mox Diamond, Wasteland, and Life from the Loam, the player aims to lock down the opponent's resources while building up their own lands. Urza's Saga, Dark Depths, and Thespian's Stage provide win conditions, while cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and Pithing Needle help to counter the opponent's threats. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Malevolent Rumble and Disruptor Flute to maintain control over the game.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, then bring them back into play for a strong attack. The deck includes various counterspells and disruptive cards to protect the combo and control the opponent's game plan. The presence of cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Murktide Regent provides card advantage and additional threats. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures early in the game and maintain control throughout the match.

The main focus of this Dragon Stompy Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base by playing cards like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon, while also playing aggressive creatures like Pyrogoyf and Broadside Bombardiers to quickly close out the game. The deck also includes powerful cards like Fury and Sundering Eruption for removal, as well as Chalice of the Void for additional disruption. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient threats while locking them out of the game with powerful enchantments.

The deck focuses on quickly milling through your library to get specific key cards into your graveyard, allowing you to win the game through a combo finish. The deck uses a combination of fast mana acceleration, low-cost spells, and graveyard recursion to power out your win condition. By leveraging cards that allow you to empty your library and win the game on the spot, while also having protection with Pact of Negation, the deck aims to overwhelm your opponent before they have a chance to stop your combo.

This deck focuses on using reanimation spells like Reanimate and Entomb to cheat powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play early in the game. It supports this strategy with disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo, while also including card draw and manipulation to find key pieces quickly. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats and control the game with spells like Wasteland and Daze, ultimately winning through powerful creature attacks and controlling the board.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, then using those creatures to win the game through combos or overwhelming the opponent. It also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces and control the opponent's game plan. The deck's strategy relies on efficiently reanimating threats while disrupting the opponent's strategy, creating a powerful and aggressive game plan that can quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory.

The main focus of this Aggro Dragon Stompy deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base by using cards like Magus of the Moon, Blood Moon, and Chalice of the Void while quickly deploying threats like Fury and Pyrogoyf to apply pressure early in the game. The deck also leverages powerful artifacts like Urza's Saga and The One Ring to generate additional value and close out games. With a mix of disruptive elements and efficient creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory through aggressive play.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the Show and Tell combo to cheat powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play for free. The deck includes counterspells like Spell Pierce and Force of Will to protect the combo, as well as card draw and manipulation with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Cunning Wish. Omniscience allows for casting spells for free once it's on the battlefield, while Stock Up can help find key pieces. The deck also includes some mana acceleration with Ancient Tomb and fetch lands.

The main concept of this deck is to use Mystic Forge along with various artifacts like Urza's Workshop, Voltaic Key, and Manifold Key to generate a powerful combo that allows for explosive plays and overwhelming board presence. The deck aims to quickly assemble the necessary pieces to overwhelm the opponent and create a dominant board state, utilizing cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Glaring Fleshraker to control the game and secure the victory. The synergy between artifacts and combo pieces allows for efficient and resilient gameplay in a Legacy 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the necessary combo pieces to win the game in a single turn. By using cards like Lotus Petal, Simian Spirit Guide, and Dark Ritual to generate mana, the deck aims to cast spells such as Pact of Negation and Reanimate to cheat out key combo pieces like Thassa's Oracle and Boggart Trawler. The goal is to mill your entire library with cards like Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer to win the game with Thassa's Oracle's enter-the-battlefield ability. The deck requires precise sequencing and careful timing to combo off successfully.

The deck aims to quickly deploy small, evasive creatures like Ornithopter and Ingenious Infiltrator to pressure the opponent's life total. Supporting cards like Baleful Strix, Retrofitter Foundry, and Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow provide additional value and card advantage. Utilizing disruptive spells like Force of Negation, Force of Will, and Fatal Push helps control the board and protect your creatures. The inclusion of ninjas like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Orcish Bowmasters enhances the aggressive strategy by dealing direct damage or limiting the opponent's options. Overall, the deck emphasizes fast-paced aggression and efficient use of card advantage to overwhelm opponents.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying threats on the board while disrupting the opponent's game plan with efficient removal and counter spells. The goal is to establish early control of the game and maintain pressure on the opponent through a combination of powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf, backed up by cards like Fatal Push and Force of Will to handle threats. The deck aims to leverage tempo advantage to outpace the opponent and secure victory through a combination of aggression and disruption.

This deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's strategy while maintaining a strong tempo advantage. By utilizing cards like Daze, Thoughtseize, and Force of Will, you can control the game and protect your key threats like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf. Aggressively removing your opponent's creatures with Fatal Push and using Brazen Borrower for additional disruption allows you to pressure your opponent and keep the game in your favor. Additionally, the mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, with cards like Wasteland and Polluted Delta providing flexibility and disruption.

The primary focus of this combo deck is to quickly and efficiently mill through the library to get key combo pieces into the graveyard, ultimately aiming to win the game through a combo involving cards such as Undercity Informer, Thassa's Oracle, and Balustrade Spy. The deck utilizes various fast mana sources like Lotus Petal and Rituals, along with disruption like Thoughtseize and Pact of Negation to protect the combo. The high-risk, high-reward nature of the deck requires careful sequencing and timing to execute the combo successfully and effectively secure the win.
